setup: DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS golden CASCADE
CREATE SCHEMA golden
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS hstore WITH SCHEMA golden
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS citext WITH SCHEMA golden
CREATE TYPE golden.mood AS ENUM ('sad', 'happy')
CREATE DOMAIN golden.posint AS integer CHECK (VALUE > 0)
CREATE TYPE golden.pair AS (a integer, b text)

CREATE TABLE golden.customers (
		id serial PRIMARY KEY,
		email text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
		name varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'anon',
		mood golden.mood,
		created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
		CONSTRAINT customers_name_check CHECK (length(name) > 0)
	)
COMMENT ON TABLE golden.customers IS 'Customers'

CREATE TABLE golden.orders (
		id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
		customer_id integer NOT NULL REFERENCES golden.customers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
		total numeric(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
		status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new',
		total_with_tax numeric(12,2) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (total * 1.2) STORED
	)
CREATE INDEX orders_customer_idx ON golden.orders (customer_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_status_partial_idx ON golden.orders (customer_id, status) WHERE status <> 'cancelled'
CREATE INDEX customers_lower_email_idx ON golden.customers (lower(email))
CREATE VIEW golden.customer_totals AS SELECT c.id, c.email, coalesce(sum(o.total), 0) AS total FROM golden.customers c LEFT JOIN golden.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.email
CREATE FUNCTION golden.touch() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN NEW.status := lower(NEW.status); RETURN NEW; END $$
CREATE TRIGGER orders_touch BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON golden.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION golden.touch()
CREATE FUNCTION golden.add(a integer, b integer DEFAULT 1) RETURNS integer LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $$ SELECT a + b $$
CREATE PROCEDURE golden.reset_status(IN target text) LANGUAGE sql AS $$ UPDATE golden.orders SET status = target $$

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "golden"."customer_totals" AS
 SELECT c.id,
    c.email,
    COALESCE(sum(o.total), 0::numeric) AS total
   FROM golden.customers c
     LEFT JOIN golden.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
  GROUP BY c.id, c.email;

CREATE TABLE "golden"."customers" (
    "id" serial NOT NULL,
    "email" text NOT NULL,
    "name" character varying(100) DEFAULT 'anon'::character varying NOT NULL,
    "mood" golden.mood,
    "created_at" timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now() NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT "customers_name_check" CHECK (length(name::text) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT "customers_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT "customers_email_key" UNIQUE (email)
);

COMMENT ON TABLE "golden"."customers" IS 'Customers';
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customers_email_key ON golden.customers USING btree (email);
CREATE INDEX customers_lower_email_idx ON golden.customers USING btree (lower(email));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customers_pkey ON golden.customers USING btree (id);

ALTER TABLE ONLY "golden"."customers"
    ADD CONSTRAINT "customers_name_check" CHECK (length(name::text) > 0);

ALTER TABLE ONLY "golden"."customers"
    ADD CONSTRAINT "customers_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id);

ALTER TABLE ONLY "golden"."customers"
    ADD CONSTRAINT "customers_email_key" UNIQUE (email);

CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW "golden"."order_counts" AS
 SELECT customer_id,
    count(*) AS n
   FROM golden.orders
  GROUP BY customer_id;
CREATE INDEX orders_customer_idx ON golden.orders USING btree (customer_id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON golden.orders USING btree (id);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_status_partial_idx ON golden.orders USING btree (customer_id, status) WHERE (status <> 'cancelled'::text);

ALTER TABLE ONLY "golden"."orders"
    ADD CONSTRAINT "orders_customer_id_fkey" FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES golden.customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE;

ALTER TABLE ONLY "golden"."orders"
    ADD CONSTRAINT "orders_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id);
CREATE TRIGGER orders_touch BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON golden.orders FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION golden.touch();
